curriculum_title: B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering (Standard Core Track)

courses.name: Data Structures and Algorithms
courses.description: Arrays, Linked Lists, Stacks, Queues, Binary Trees, Graphs, Sorting algorithms, Big O notation, Dynamic Programming in C++.

courses.name: Database Management Systems
courses.description: Relational algebra, SQL, Normalization (1NF, 2NF, 3NF, BCNF), ER modeling, Transactions, ACID properties, indexing using PostgreSQL/MySQL.

courses.name: Object Oriented Programming & Software Engineering
courses.description: Object-oriented principles (OOP), Java, Design patterns, Waterfall & Agile methodologies, Unit testing with JUnit, Git version control basics.

courses.name: Web Technologies & Computer Networks
courses.description: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript ES6 basics, DOM manipulation, HTTP/HTTPS protocols, TCP/IP, RESTful APIs, basic Node.js and Express backend setup.
